name: Spirit Island
variant: base game, optional scoring (Spirit Island scoring formula)

categories.label: Performance score
categories.hint: won=1 if victory, 0 if defeat. difficulty = total difficulty. invadersLeft = cards left in deck (victory). invadersUsed = cards not in deck (defeat). dahan/blight = living Dahan and Blight on island.

winCondition: Win immediately when the current Terror Level victory condition is met (Level 1 clear all Invaders, Level 2 no Towns/Cities, Level 3 no Cities, reaching Level 4 also wins). Lose if the last Blight leaves the Blight Card with a lose effect, any Spirit has no Presence left, or an Invader card must be drawn from an empty deck. An effect that both wins and loses is a Sacrifice Victory.
notes: family: coop. Verified against the official Rules Reference v1.2 (p.23 optional scoring, p.12 victory and defeat): victory 5x Difficulty +10 +2 per Invader card left in deck; defeat 2x Difficulty +1 per Invader card not in deck (discard and face-up); both add 1 per X living Dahan and subtract 1 per X Blight on island, X = number of players. Rulebook does not state rounding for per-X; modelled as round down. Score is optional and only for comparing games. Difficulty comes from Adversary/Scenario cards (scorer input). Expansions add content but not scoring rules.

sources.title: Spirit Island Rules Reference v1.2
sources.section: Scoring (Optional), p.23; Victory and Defeat, p.12

endCondition.description: Win immediately on meeting the current Terror Level victory condition; lose on last Blight, a Spirit destroyed, or empty Invader deck.
